esp32.detail: 4 pins wired; HPMA115S0 laser PM2.5/PM10 particle sensor needs at least 4.8 V, so it is powered from 5 V. U2.TX → RX2 (the board's RX), RX → TX2 (the board's TX). Added the hpma115s0.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the PM2.5 and PM10 set on the sliders: passes

pico.detail: 4 pins wired; HPMA115S0 laser PM2.5/PM10 particle sensor needs at least 4.8 V, so it is powered from 5 V. U2.TX → GP1 (the board's RX), RX → GP0 (the board's TX). Added the hpma115s0.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the PM2.5 and PM10 set on the sliders: passes
